profile.dividendPolicy: The Company has a policy to pay dividends of not less than 50 per cent of the net profit in the consolidated financial statements after deduction of corporate income tax, excluding unrealised gains or losses on exchange rates, subject to the investment plan and other relevant factors, whereby the Board of Directors may consider reviewing or amending the dividend payment policy from time to time in order to be in line with the Company's future business growth plan, the requirements for investment funds and such other factors as it deems appropriate. In this regard, such dividend payment shall not exceed the retained earnings appearing in the financial statements of the Company.
